title: One-field concentration and rigidity of normalized tower orientations
statement: Fix the finite-field datum [def-pur-conventions]: an algebraic closure k of a finite field of characteristic p and a prime ell different from p. Let E be one finite extension of Q_ell in the coefficient closure [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let X,Y be separated finite-type k-schemes, X noetherian, and f:X to Y smooth separated of pure relative dimension d >= 0 [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sf-setting], with a fixed open/proper compactification f=j followed by p. Work in the ordinary derived categories of strict O_E/ell^bullet module-sheaf towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Fix the normalized whole-system models, domains and tower/finite adjunctions b,a,A with their counit-normalized evaluations [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models, def-sp-field-exceptional-system-domains, def-sp-field-exceptional-system-adjoints]. Let J_E,T=(O_E/ell^(n+1))_T be the coefficient unit; assume J_E,Y lies in the normalized constructible subcategory [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Fix root-normalized finite coordinates w on X and v on Y, and put L=J_E,X(d)[2d] in the ordered positive tensor convention [def-sp-tower-gamma-data]. Put omega=G_E(J_E,Y), for the supplied right adjoint. Suppose o:L isomorphic to omega is normalized at every n >= 0 by the specified diagonal/DNC maps [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps]. Then (1) H^i(omega)=0 for i different from -2d; (2) writing M=H^0(L[-2d]) and N=H^0(omega[-2d]), there are identifications M[0] isomorphic to L[-2d] and N[0] isomorphic to omega[-2d], inducing the canonical single/H-zero identity on cohomology, and a unique sheaf-system map h:M to N whose shifted derived map is o under those identifications. For every n and every sheaf map beta:e_n M to e_n N, reconstruction of e_n(o) from beta through these identifications is equivalent to beta=e_n(h). This is precisely the normalized beta/evaluation characterization of [lem-sp-strict-line-heart-assembly]. (3) Every derived morphism L to omega with the same finite diagonal/DNC normalization equals o. This theorem involves only E and no coefficient extension.

proof.text:
Evaluate the ordered Tate line using its root-normalized lineWord. A finite Tate
line is a locally free degree-zero sheaf with shift 2d, so every evaluation is
concentrated in degree -2d. Exact evaluation commutes with homology, and a strict
sheaf-system is zero when all its levels are zero. Thus the ordered line is
concentrated there. Transport this along o to the dualizing system.
After shifting by -2d, use the single/H-zero isomorphism, normalized by its induced
map on H-zero, for both objects. Full faithfulness of single recovers the unique
heart map of o. Naturality of evaluationSingleShift gives the beta/evaluation
characterization in IsHeartInduced; faithfulness of the finite single and shift
functors proves the reverse implication and uniqueness of beta.
For any other normalized orientation, its finite diagonal maps equal those of o:
the diagonal/DNC normalization is unique, as are the counit-normalized right-adjoint
comparisons and the unit comparison. Remove the shift and use fullness of single
to express both arrows as maps of the same heart sheaves. Faithfulness of finite
single and shift then gives equality of every component of these heart maps.
Strict sheaf-system extensionality gives their equality, and shifting back proves
equality of the original arrows. This uses evaluation only on shifted sheaves.

lean.statement: theorem field_orientation_system_rigidity [IsNoetherian X] [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [(j ≫ p).IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (j ≫ p)] [QuasiCompact (j ≫ p)] [HasCompactification (j ≫ p)] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)] (E : Index P) (w : Coordinates P D E X) (v : Coordinates P D E Y) (h : normalized P D E Y (SpTowerGamma.unit P.coefficients.l E.val Y)) (o : line P D w d ≅ omega P D j p b a A E h) (ho : IsOrientation P D j p b a A E d w v h o.hom) : (∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ -2 * (d : ℤ) → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (omega P D j p b a A E h))) ∧ IsHeartInduced P D w d (omega P D j p b a A E h) o.hom ∧ (∀ f : line P D w d ⟶ omega P D j p b a A E h, IsOrientation P D j p b a A E d w v h f → f = o.hom)
